cat >> target/specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md <<EOF

## Delivery over WebSocket

A summary's \`createdAt\` and \`updatedAt\` are sent as ISO strings, because a \`Date\` does not survive \`JSON.stringify\` as a \`Date\` ([validated by: returns a conversation list when history is enabled](../../src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L32)).
EOF
cd target && node scripts/check-spec-links.mjs && node scripts/check-spec-status.mjs && node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs

cd target && git add .lore/dod.md src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git commit -m "docs: define DONE for #144 with acceptance tests and spec updates" && git push origin HEAD
cd target && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
